purpose: Acquire and validate one materially different multiclass image domain before freezing the P6-B external-validation experiment.

selection_rationale.reason: Nine-class histopathology supplies a materially different visual domain and a test set from a different clinical center, while retaining the 28x28 resolution needed for a bounded CPU pilot.
selection_rationale.scope_constraint: Dataset acquisition is not evidence and does not authorize model training. Training begins only after this acquisition gate passes and a separate experiment protocol is frozen.

dataset_contract.test_domain_note: CRC-VAL-HE-7K from a different clinical center is used as the official test split.

pass_gate: downloaded byte count is positive and no greater than maximum_accepted_bytes
MD5 exactly matches the official expected_md5
all and only expected NPZ keys are present
every split has the frozen image and label shapes
images are uint8 and labels are integer-valued
every split contains all nine frozen labels
an observed SHA-256 and per-split class histogram are recorded
failure_policy: Stop without training. Do not repair, mirror, subset, or silently replace the file under this protocol.
